description: The line plot illustrates the average correct gate rate across different input types and model configurations, with the x-axis representing the layer number ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 5, and the y-axis showing the average correct gate rate on a scale from 0.0 to 1.0. The plot includes four distinct lines: a solid blue line labeled "Character Attention input," a dashed blue line labeled "Character MLP input," a solid red line labeled "Wiki Attention input," and a dashed red line labeled "Wiki MLP input." The "Character Attention input" line starts at approximately 0.2 at layer 0, rises sharply to about 0.8 at layer 5, then declines to around 0.4 at layer 10, and subsequently increases to about 0.7 at layer 30. The "Character MLP input" line begins at approximately 0.8 at layer 0, dips slightly to around 0.7 at layer 5, rises to about 0.9 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.8 and 0.9 until layer 30. The "Wiki Attention input" line starts at around 0.2 at layer 0, increases to about 0.8 at layer 5, drops to approximately 0.4 at layer 10, and then rises to about 0.7 at layer 30. The "Wiki MLP input" line begins at around 0.8 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.6 at layer 5, rises to approximately 0.9 at layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.8 and 0.9 until layer 30. The shaded regions around each line represent the confidence intervals, indicating the variability in the data.
